I understand you're calling about a potential duplicate charge on your recent invoice and would like to request a credit.  Before I can look into your account details,  I need to verify your identity first.
 
Could you please provide your email address?
Thank you.  Could you please provide your phone number?
Thank you.   Could you please provide your date of birth?
My date of birth is the 2nd of November 1981.Is there anything else you need to verify,  or can we proceed with checking the invoice details?
Thank you for providing those details.   Let me now pull up your account information to look into the invoice you mentioned.

I can see your most recent invoice is INV-2026-0020 from the twenty-sixth of July.    You mentioned a potential duplicate charge for red fabric of about a hundred francs.   

To process a credit request,  I need to identify the specific charge this relates to.   Could you confirm if this is regarding invoice INV-2026-0020,  or is it a different invoice?

I've requested a credit of one hundred francs against invoice INV-2026-0020 for the potential duplicate charge you mentioned.    A colleague will review this request and follow up with you.
 
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
